{{Quote|I'll escort you as far as the wall. I'm sure you were told it is planted with cloudflower vines. It may not surprise you to find that isn't the case. Like peace and justice on Romin, the name of the wall is just an illusion.|Romin Citizens' Resistance leader Joylin, to undercover Jedi Anakin Skywalker and Ferus Olin|<ref name="Changing of the Guard" />}}
'''Cloudflower vines''' were a type of [[Vine/Legends|vine]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romin]]. Romin's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Eliior]], was surrounded by the [[Cloudflower Wall]], a structure that was supposedly planted with cloudflower vines in order to give people on the other side of the wall the impression that they lived within the wilderness.<ref name="Changing of the Guard" />
